ecosystems.name: Heat-pump lifecycle / replacement ecosystem
ecosystems.definition: Large Swedish heat-pump base with explicit replacement wave; unusually mature local spare-parts/service commerce makes Sweden a source-market oracle more than a generic target.
ecosystems.next_action: Use Sweden as source-market catalogue oracle; only investigate long-tail obsolete-model cells after exact query and merchant census.

ecosystems.name: Smart-meter / household energy-management ecosystem
ecosystems.definition: ~5.7m meter points with near-universal smart-meter readiness and open customer interfaces, but mature Tibber/HomeWizard/Greenely execution.
falsifiers: tariff policy no longer universally mandates effect fees
ecosystems.next_action: Treat generic meter readers as killed. Track only meter/protocol/network-specific interoperability failures and new tariff/EV/solar integration gaps.

ecosystems.name: Solar lifecycle / retrofit ecosystem
ecosystems.definition: 314k+ grid-connected solar systems with sharply slowing new-installation growth, shifting opportunity from panel acquisition toward lifecycle, replacement, retrofit and integration.
falsifiers: OEM/installer channels fully own replacement purchases
consumer self-install prohibited/unsafe for target parts
ecosystems.next_action: Build inverter/optimizer installed-cohort proxies by brand/model, scrape Swedish exact-model merchant coverage, and measure replacement/retrofit queries.

ecosystems.name: EV model-cohort aftermarket
ecosystems.definition: Rapid BEV penetration with new models entering more segments; opportunity hypothesis is cohort growth outrunning local exact-model catalogue growth, not generic EV accessories.
falsifiers: local accessory specialists catch cohorts immediately
ecosystems.next_action: Pull exact make/model cohort stock; precommit top growth cohorts; compare local vs German/global exact-model assortments before paid tests.

ecosystems.name: Holiday-home remote resilience ecosystem
ecosystems.definition: 633,861 Swedish holiday homes create durable frost/power/water jobs, but Swedish merchants already provide mature 4G/SMS remote monitoring and security solutions.
falsifiers: cross-system interoperability fails to create demand
ecosystems.next_action: Use Swedish merchants as source-market oracle for Norway/Denmark; only retain narrow fail-safe/interoperability cells.

ecosystems.name: Radon / indoor-air measurement ecosystem
ecosystems.definition: Nearly 400k homes estimated above radon reference level and strong official measurement guidance, but consumer radon monitoring products already have broad direct/price-comparison distribution.
falsifiers: measurement service rather than commerce captures value
ecosystems.next_action: Do not launch generic radon meter store; test only service/content/post-mitigation niches if native query economics justify.
